orientation.purpose: Compact orientation to the published Meta Research record. Follow evidence_url before making substantive claims.
orientation.entry_point_policy: Latest work, latest negative result, and earliest published record; duplicates are removed.

entry_points.title: Grounded build-time labnote summarization
entry_points.question: Can a versioned AI apparatus produce concise labnote orientations that preserve findings, limitations, and negative results without introducing unsupported claims?
entry_points.finding: All eight v3 candidates passed the structural checks without language warnings, and the human reviewer accepted all eight as useful for understanding their source notes quickly. The frozen gate required at least seven acceptances, so the v3 campaign passed.

disclaimers.evidence: This overview routes readers to published labnotes; it is not itself evidence.
disclaimers.relations: Relations are human-authored provenance statements, not automatic proof of causality or support.
disclaimers.similarity: Similarity geometry is omitted here. Its projection is navigational, corpus-relative, lossy, and not evidence of causality.
disclaimers.generated_summaries: Derived AI summaries are absent unless explicitly labeled with provenance and review status.
